contract.words: Collect $3,000 of settled cash within 30 days using no up-front capital.

terms.proofCondition: $3,000 of settled cash received within 30 days

strategy.title: Sell the chemical safety binder to 10 licensed hair salons at $350
strategy.why: Every chain link is evidenced on the card: 18 salons paid $350 (payment records 2026-11-04..22), 18/150 conversion measured on this offer, 300 licensed salons reachable by email, Brain produces the spreadsheet, $5 cost, $0 exposure, 4 days to cash. 10 deals = $3,500 gross, $3,450 net, above the $3,000 target with ~90 contacts of 282 not yet sold.

alternatives.title: Sell exactly 9 binders ($3,150)
alternatives.why: Meets target with no margin for a refund; 10 gives a buffer at negligible cost.

steps.label: Email ~100 salons from the county cosmetology establishment licence list that have not yet bought
Offer the chemical safety data-sheet and exposure-log binder at $350, paid before delivery
Close 10 salons at $350 (12% measured conversion on ~100 contacts)
Collect $350 from each of 10 salons
Brain produces and delivers 10 binders (spreadsheet), $5 direct cost each

cash.label: Direct cost $5 x 10, paid after receipts settle

sources.claim: 18 salons paid $350 each for the binder (payment records 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-22)
300 salons hold county cosmetology establishment licences

strategy.title: No plan: the salon binder's price is contradicted ($350 on the card, $35 in the evidence)
strategy.why: The card's evidence now records the binder's price as $35, while the card's price field still says $350; the earlier fact (18 salons paid $350, payment records) is no longer on the card. At $35 the target needs 86 sales, but the 300 licensed salons at the measured 18/150 conversion yield about 36 (~$1,260); at $350 it needs 9. Which price salons pay decides the plan, and it is not established.

alternatives.title: Sell at $35 to all 300 salons
alternatives.why: Needs 86 sales, about 29% of the whole pool against a measured 12% conversion; about 36 sales ($1,260) is what the evidence supports.

noPlan.decisiveGap: The price is contradicted: the card's evidence records $35 per binder while its price field says $350, and the payment-record fact at $350 is gone. At $35 the 300 salons at the measured 12% conversion yield about 36 sales (~$1,260), far short of $3,000; at $350, 9 sales suffice. Until one price is established, neither the offer's price nor whether the market holds enough sales can be decided.
noPlan.resolution: Brain reconciles the price against the salons' payment records for the 18 sales (2026-11-04 to 2026-11-22) and records the paid amount as evidence. If $350 is confirmed, the 10-sale plan (~84 fresh contacts of the 150 uncontacted salons, $5 cost, 4 days to cash) is executable; if $35 is confirmed, the target cannot be reached from this market and needs either a higher-priced offer with evidenced buyers or further openings.

Sell Chemical safety data-sheet and exposure-log binder for hair salons to each buyer.

reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is justified. Price is evidenced by 18 payment records at $350 from the same buyer population (hair salons, 2026-11-04..22); conversion 18/150 = 12% measured on this offer; 300 licensed salons are reachable via the county licence list; Brain has proved PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET; $5 cost, $0 exposure, 4 days to cash. Arithmetic: 9 deals x $350 = $3,150 already clears $3,000; the plan takes 10 = $3,500 gross, $3,450 net after $50 cost paid after receipts. 300 - 150 contacted = 150 uncontacted salons; at 12% they yield ~18 sales expected, so 10 needs ~84 fresh contacts - within the pool and inside 30 days (receipts day 5, settled day 9). Spend $50 is paid from settled receipts, so no owner funding and exposure stays $0.
findings: Step s1 says 'salons that have not yet bought'; the 132 already-contacted non-buyers should not be counted at 12%. Target the 150 uncontacted salons (all of them, to buy margin against variance: 10 of ~100 at p=0.12 is only roughly a coin-flip-plus; all 150 gives ~18 expected).
SEND_A_MESSAGE and ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED; s1-s4 cannot run until they are connected.
The ledger collapses ten receipts into one $3,500 entry on day 5; receipts will arrive across days 5-20, still inside the window.

reviews.reasons: Withdrawing the EXECUTABLE plan is right. The card's price fact is now the bare EVIDENCE '$35'; the payment-record fact (18 salons at $350) that carried the previous plan is gone, and the card's priceCents $350 has no sourced fact behind it, so the price is contradicted and Brain's own OFFER_AND_PRICE link is false ('no single price on the card'). The plan cannot rest on $350. Arithmetic: at $35, $3,000 needs ceil(3000/35) = 86 sales (gross); at the measured 12% that needs ~717 contacts against 300 licensed salons, so MARKET_VOLUME also fails at that price, which the revision names. At $350, 9 sales suffice. NO_PLAN with OFFER_AND_PRICE decisive (MARKET_VOLUME dependent on it) is the right stance, stated as a gap, not a constraint - correct, since even at $35 full conversion of the pool is not ruled out by evidence, only by the measured rate. The resolution - reconcile against the 18 payment records and record the paid amount - is the right evidence (what these buyers actually paid), and both branches are stated.
findings: '300 salons at 12% yield about 36 sales' counts the 150 already contacted (18 of whom already bought before the window). Only the 150 uncontacted salons are fresh: ~18 more sales, ~$630 at $35. The conclusion (far short) is unchanged, but the figure overstates the pool by 2x.
The 18 earlier sales (2026-11-04..22) were before the goal's window and cannot count toward settled cash in it, whatever price is confirmed.
The bare '$35' fact has no unit or context; the reconciliation should also establish whether $35 is a per-binder price, a partial payment, or a data-entry error against the $350 records.
